Roy Halladay

Position: Pitcher

Bats: Right  •  Throws: Right

6-6, 225lb (198cm, 102kg)

Born: May 14, 1977 in Denver, CO us

Died: November 7, 2017 in Holiday, FL

Buried: Cremated

Draft: Drafted by the Toronto Blue Jays in the 1st round (17th) of the 1995 MLB June Amateur Draft from Arvada West HS (Arvada, CO).

High School: Arvada West HS (Arvada, CO)

Debut: September 20, 1998 (Age 21-129d, 17,318th in major league history)
   vs. TBD 5.0 IP, 8 H, 5 SO, 2 BB, 2 ER

Last Game: September 23, 2013 (Age 36-132d)
   vs. MIA 0.1 IP, 0 H, 0 SO, 2 BB, 1 ER, L

Hall of Fame: Inducted as Player in 2019. (Voted by BBWAA on 363/425 ballots)
   View Roy Halladay's Page at the Baseball Hall of Fame (plaque, photos, videos).

Rookie Status: Exceeded rookie limits during 1999 season

Agents: CAA Sports • Previously: Randy Hendricks, Alan Hendricks

Full Name: Harry Leroy Halladay

Nicknames: Doc

Pronunciation: \HAL-ah-day\

Frequently Asked Questions

When was Roy Halladay born?

Roy Halladay was born on May 14, 1977.

Where was Roy Halladay born?

Roy Halladay was born in Denver, CO.

How tall was Roy Halladay?

Roy Halladay was 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much did Roy Halladay weigh when playing?

Roy Halladay weighed 225 lbs (102 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Roy Halladay play?

Roy Halladay played 16 seasons.

Is Roy Halladay in the Hall of Fame?

Roy Halladay was elected into the Hall of Fame in 2019.

When was Roy Halladay drafted?

Roy Halladay was drafted by the Toronto Blue Jays in the 1st round (17th) of the 1995 MLB June Amateur Draft from Arvada West HS (Arvada, CO).

What position did Roy Halladay play?

Roy Halladay was a Pitcher.

How many strikeouts did Roy Halladay have?

Roy Halladay had 2,117 strikeouts over his career.

How many teams has Roy Halladay played for?

Roy Halladay played for 2 teams; the Philadelphia Phillies and Toronto Blue Jays.

How many World Series has Roy Halladay won?

Roy Halladay never won a World Series.

When did Roy Halladay retire?

Roy Halladay last played in 2013.

What are Roy Halladay's nicknames?

Doc is a nickname for Roy Halladay.
